title: Apollo 16 landing site (Moon)

place.label: Descartes, the Moon
place.basis: Latitude and longitude as published by NSSDCA, referenced to the DE421 Mean Earth/Polar Axis lunar reference frame

measures.label: Latitude and longitude on the Moon

facts.text: NSSDCA's Apollo table lists Apollo 16: launched 16 April 1972, landed 20 April 1972 at Descartes (8.973 S, 15.501 E).

tiers.everyday: Apollo 16 landed on the Moon on 20 April 1972 in Descartes. NASA lists the site at 8.973 S, 15.501 E on the Moon.
tiers.student: NSSDCA's Apollo table lists a launch on 16 April 1972, 20.23 hours of moonwalk time, a traverse length [UNKNOWN] and 95.71 kg of samples. Coordinates use the DE421 Mean Earth/Polar Axis frame.

unknowns: IAU Gazetteer name for this landing point: not looked up [UNKNOWN] (only the Apollo 11 name was checked)
Traverse length: the NSSDCA table prints it with the digits after the decimal point missing (the page prints "27.")
